accessibility.accessibleNameSource: alt on sb-avatar-image; label on sb-avatar-fallback and sb-avatar-group-count (role img); label on sb-avatar-badge. Without a label, plain text inside the fallback or count is read as text.
aria: image: native img with alt; empty alt makes it decorative
fallback: with label set, role=img and aria-label are set before first render
group count: with label set, role=img and aria-label are set before first render
badge: with label set, role=img and aria-label; otherwise aria-hidden=true
the hidden image or fallback is removed from the accessibility tree (hidden attribute)
data-image-status and data-size are presentation-only host attributes
sb-avatar-image with an empty alt takes the sibling sb-avatar-fallback label as the image alt, so the avatar keeps its name once the image replaces the fallback
accessibility.role: none (generic); the image has role img from the native img element
accessibility.targetSize: Not interactive. Put an avatar inside a button or link to make it a control; that control sets the target size.

antiPatterns.why: A failed or slow image leaves an empty circle

antiPatterns.alternative: Give the badge a label, or show the status as text nearby
antiPatterns.pattern: Presence shown by badge color alone
antiPatterns.why: Color cannot be the only signal

useCases.use: sb-avatar with sb-avatar-image and a sb-avatar-fallback of initials
useCases.when: Show who a comment, row or card belongs to

useCases.use: sb-avatar-group with a sb-avatar-group-count for the rest

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: The host is the circle and the positioning context for the badge. It tracks whether its image has loaded and shows the fallback until then.

default.notes: sb-avatar-image, sb-avatar-fallback and an optional sb-avatar-badge.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.notes: Native img inside the shadow root.

alt.note: Text alternative. Empty means the image is decorative, which suits an avatar whose name is written next to it.

src.note: Image address. Changing it starts a new load and brings the fallback back until it finishes.

elements.summary: The picture. It stays hidden until it has loaded, and reports success or failure to the surrounding avatar.

label.note: Accessible name for initials or an icon. When set the fallback is exposed as an image with this name.

elements.summary: Shown while there is no loaded image: initials, an icon or any short content, on a muted disc.

label.note: Says what the badge means (for example Online). Without it the badge is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

elements.summary: A small status dot at the bottom end of the avatar, optionally holding an icon (hidden at size small).

default.notes: sb-avatar elements and an optional sb-avatar-group-count.

elements.notes: Sets data-size on itself from its avatars (large, else small, else medium) so the count matches.
elements.summary: Overlaps its avatars in a row; each gets a ring in the page background so the edges stay readable. Author may set role=group and aria-label on it.

default.notes: A short count such as +3, or an icon.

label.note: Accessible name for the count or an icon (for example 3 more members). When set the count is exposed as an image with this name.

elements.summary: A disc, sized like the group's avatars, showing how many more there are.

openQuestions.answer: Context from sb-avatar; status reflected in data-image-status.
openQuestions.question: How do the image and the fallback coordinate across shadow roots?
openQuestions.recommendation: The avatar provides a context (@lit/context) holding the image status; the image reports load and error, the fallback hides itself when loaded.

openQuestions.question: Name for initials and for the badge?
openQuestions.recommendation: A label prop on the fallback and on the badge sets role=img and aria-label; without a label the badge is decorative.

openQuestions.answer: Badge diameter is 30% of the avatar size; logged as drift.
openQuestions.question: Badge size tokens (8, 10 and 12px do not exist in the size scale)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Derive from the avatar diameter (30%) in CSS.

size.note: Diameter from the media size tokens: 32px, 24px or 40px.

image-loading.note: The fallback is visible and the image hidden. The avatar reflects the status in data-image-status (idle, loaded, error).
image-loading.trigger: image has not loaded, or failed to load

contract.summary: A circular picture or initials that represent a person or entity, with an optional status badge and an overlapping group (a family of Web Components).

# Plan: Avatar (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-avatar` (size medium|small|large) with `sb-avatar-image`, `sb-avatar-fallback`, `sb-avatar-badge`, `sb-avatar-group`, `sb-avatar-group-count`. The fallback shows until the image has loaded, and on error.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/avatar/Avatar.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/avatar/avatar.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/avatar/Avatar.scss` -> `Avatar.styles.ts` (generated, shared) |
| 4 | `context.ts`, `Avatar.ts`, `AvatarImage.ts`, `AvatarFallback.ts`, `AvatarBadge.ts`, `AvatarGroup.ts`, `AvatarGroupCount.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Tokens
`avatar.*` aliases semantic tokens, using the shared `size.media.*`, `space.stack.*`, `border-width.thick`.

## Test plan (test-first)
- Sizes per `size`; reflection.
- Image status: slow load keeps the fallback visible, then swaps; a failing source keeps the fallback; changing `src` returns to the fallback; `data-image-status` follows.
- Accessibility tree: image name from `alt`; hidden parts are absent; fallback `label` gives role img; badge `label` or aria-hidden.
- Badge geometry and ring; icon hidden at sm. Group overlap, ring, count size follows the group.
- Colors in light and dark; axe clean.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
- `label` props for naming initials and the badge (the reference has none).

## Open questions
- Q1 Image/fallback coordination: answered, context.
- Q2 Naming initials and badge: answered, `label` props.
- Q3 Badge sizes: answered, 30% of the avatar.
